raw.path: raw/papers/1998_Petrache et al_Lifetime measurements of highly deformed bands in 1 3 4 , 1 3 5 Nd and 131 Ce.pdf

coverage: R10–R11 (PDF 1–2): experimental motivation, reaction, GASP/ISIS, angle-selected spectra, fractional shift and the top of each band.
R12–R13 (PDF 3–4): Table I, stopping and side-feeding model, uncertainty, the absolute fitted band moments and conditional shape comparison.
R14 (PDF 5): further analysis, conclusion and references.
reader: Previously documented full reading plus Codex checks of the published pages and the feeding language.
evidence_boundary: Unobserved thick-target upper-band branches were taken from earlier thin-target spectroscopy for the feeding model.
Double gates alter which levels retain side feeding. Unresolved feeding is represented by one effective cascade; no per-transition lifetime determination is claimed.
Do not transfer HD-band moments to 135Nd chiral bands or to 131Ce normal-deformed yrast levels.
next_action: Reconcile Li 2004 and Singh 2016 original 131Ce level lifetimes and identify their distinct normal-deformation gates and feeding models.
